cascadeInspection: Independent review compared the authenticated complete Relume Header15 anatomy with the final DOM, CSS cascade, link destinations, image asset, and all nine cache-busted render states. One content-height section owns one constrained ren-stack container, one responsive ren-switcher copy region with exactly one h1 on the left and one description plus exactly two real CTA anchors on the right, followed by exactly one full-width rounded landscape image. The image is owned, meaningful, intrinsically sized 1440 by 900, uses cover fitting, and remains below the copy without overflow. The copy stays in source-ordered one-column flow through 767px and forms two equal top-aligned columns at 768px; actions wrap cleanly at 320px. Desktop light/dark, 768, 767, 390, 320, reduced-motion focus, mobile dark, and no-JavaScript captures preserve content height, hierarchy, contrast, focus, and 44px targets. No viewport forcing, overlay, scrim, video, form, navigation, logo, dialog, third action, duplicate tree, framework code, raw flex/grid skeleton, forbidden palette token, or chromatic literal remains.
